MCP, or **Model Context Protocol**, is an open protocol that allows LLM applications to connect more consistently to external tools and data sources. > It is the communication and capability exposure standard that allows a host, through a client, to talk to one or more servers.

It stops you from reinventing every integration by hand Without MCP, the world quickly turns into this: - every external system gets a bespoke integration - every tool has its own schema and conventions - permissions, authentication, validation, and result formats are all handled differently - switching to a different AI client often means doing much of the work again MCP does not eliminate all integration effort, but it standardises the foundation.
